summary: Iteration-2 regression on Kyrenis Pharmacy OS. All 3 fixes from iteration-1 verified: (1) sample GTINs 89000000000014/21/38 pass Mod-10 — CLEAN writes inventory (status=Valid, inventory_written=True); RECALL hits CDSCO with final_alert.title='CDSCO Recall Hit'; MISMATCH fails at Check-1 Packaging Metadata (2) OCR expiry regex now EXP-anchored, no false MFG collision (3) Telemetry tab renders all 4 sections (volumetric, spatial, security-alerts, cdsco) with zero runtime errors. Pytest 24/24 pass after updating stale GTIN literals in test_kyrenis_api.py. Full frontend happy-path succeeds end-to-end. Consumer presets return correct shields (green/red/red). Drug Safety Directory returns Ibuprofen results with warnings. JWT guard: /api/pharmacy/* unauth→401, /api/consumer/verify-batch and /api/consumer/openfda work anonymously (200). Landing 'Distribution Hubs' stat now renders '5'. KyrenisLogo SVG present on Landing, Pharmacy, and Patient pages.

minor.issue: Persisted alerts survive stale demo data — repeated intake of same batch (e.g. CRO241001) leaves security_alerts rows that then cause the /api/consumer/verify-batch of the same batch to return RED. Reset flow / TTL cleanup would keep the CLEAN consumer preset reliable across demo sessions. (Cleaned manually during this run.)
Still does not enforce Mod-10 while pharmacy/intake does — divergent verdict surface for the same GTIN if it happens to be malformed.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking [data-testid='logout-btn'] on /pharmacy did NOT clear session / navigate to landing during test — URL remained /pharmacy and subsequent visit to /patient still showed 'chemist@kyrenis.in · PHARMACY STAFF · VERIFIED' in the top strip. Likely: logout handler does not await cookie deletion / does not navigate. Needs verification.

When a JWT cookie is present, the /patient anonymous hub still renders the pharmacy user identity + LOGOUT button in the header. Patient hub is supposed to be anonymous — the header component should hide the auth pill when on /patient, or /patient should not read pharmacy auth context.

At tab-open time all 109 <option> elements were disabled (stockByMed still loading) — for ~1-2s the user cannot add anything to the cart. Consider disabling the select itself (loading state) until stockByMed resolves, or optimistically enabling based on medicine list.
Hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' still present (not addressed in iteration-2; carried over from iteration-1). Non-blocking.

issues: Jet black background, dark charcoal panels (k-panel), deep navy header on /pharmacy, soft grey text, emerald safe (#10B981), crimson danger — all present and consistent across Landing, Auth, Pharmacy, Patient.

action_items: Fix pharmacy /logout button to actually clear cookies and redirect to '/' (or verify why the click was a no-op during Playwright run).
Hide the pharmacy-user auth pill inside /patient header (anonymous surface) even when a JWT cookie is present.
Consider TTL-purging security_alerts persisted from demo intakes so the CLEAN consumer preset stays green after repeated pharmacy demos.
(Carry-over) Fix <span> inside <option> hydration warning in StockIntake medicine SKU select.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stock_intake persists security_alerts even when verification fails at Check-1 without any inventory write — over time this pollutes /api/consumer/verify-batch verdicts for the same batch numbers. Add a demo-reset endpoint or scope to real pharmacy_id only.
verification.py _yy_mm_from_ocr regex now correctly prefers EXP-anchored capture and falls back to last YYYY-MM — good; consider also parsing 'MM/YYYY' explicitly for robustness.
Telemetry.jsx: per-endpoint try/catch + defensive [] defaults are in place — tab no longer crashes. Good.

PatientHub reads auth context and shows pharmacy identity — likely uses shared <Header> component; refactor to accept a `variant='anonymous'` prop for /patient or route-conditionally hide the user pill.
test_kyrenis_api.py class-scoped fixture defined as instance method emits PytestRemovedIn10Warning; convert to @classmethod for future compatibility.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_kyrenis_api.py (updated stale 089... GTIN literals to new 890... valid Mod-10 GTINs; adjusted CLEAN9999 batch length to satisfy telemetry engines)

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows pass; logout no-op and patient-hub auth-pill leak are the only defects)

seed_data_creation: None. Manually deleted 3 stale security_alerts rows (batches CRO241001, ABC000111, CLEAN9999 leftovers) to restore CLEAN consumer preset to green.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 iteration-1 regressions verified fixed. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_kyrenis_api.py — 24/24 green. Frontend Playwright happy-path completes end-to-end. Remaining defects are LOW-MEDIUM (logout no-op, /patient auth pill leak, POS select loading race, hydration warning). If demo requires repeat runs of the CLEAN consumer preset, run: python3 -c "import pymongo;pymongo.MongoClient('mongodb://localhost:27017')['test_database'].security_alerts.delete_many({'target_batch_number':{'$in':['CRO241001','CLEAN9999','ABC000111']}})" between sessions.

rca_of_the_issues.logout_no_op: Clicking [data-testid='logout-btn'] returned no navigation and cookies persisted so the /patient anonymous page continued to render 'chemist@kyrenis.in · PHARMACY STAFF · VERIFIED'. Suspect: onClick calls auth.logout() but does not await, or the shared header renders regardless of auth context on /patient. Reproduction: login → open /pharmacy → click logout → observe URL still /pharmacy AND revisiting /patient shows the identity pill.
rca_of_the_issues.patient_hub_auth_leak: The <Header> component on /patient consults the same AuthContext used by /pharmacy. On anonymous surfaces the header should default to guest pill only. Reproduction: login as pharmacy staff → navigate directly to /patient → identity pill and LOGOUT button appear in header.
